limits: Captured authentication snapshot is injected; SQL tests do not exercise real login cookies, middleware or CSRF.
Permission removal fixture changes only the permission to isolate revalidation independently of security-version rotation.
The deadline case waits on a real PostgreSQL target row lock observed through pg_stat_activity; the TOTP proof timestamp is a fixture, not a real TOTP exchange.
Tests cover the listed interleavings and database effects, not every possible concurrent administrative operation or a load benchmark.

An intermediate rerun hit the single-protected-user fixture constraint; the fixture now reuses the existing protected account in this explicitly isolated test database. No product migration was needed.
